name: Pixel city
doc: A pixel-art city at night on a low-res grid: three parallax rows of towers (the middle row rises and falls with the spectrum like an equalizer), windows that flicker on the hi-hats, neon signs pumping with the bass, roof beacons blinking on the beat, a street of head- and taillights, slanted rain and falling note sprites; `flash` lights the sky like lightning (bind to an onset envelope).

pixels.doc: grid height in pixels; match the pixel-art effect

hats.doc: how much the hi-hats flicker the windows

flash.doc: lightning; bind to an onset envelope

hue.doc: shifts the neon colours around the wheel
